claims.text: Generalized and recalcitrant disease, and sometimes to lower the corticosteroid dose: methotrexate, azathioprine, mycophenolate mofetil or cyclosporine
claims.quote: For patients with generalized and recalcitrant disease, and sometimes to decrease corticosteroid dose in chronic disease, immunosuppressants such as methotrexate, azathioprine, mycophenolate mofetil, and cyclosporine may be used.
